rev.t: Palestra is an excellent gym with a great atmosphere, well-maintained equipment, and a motivating environment. A special mention to Raghvendra, who is an amazing instructor—knowledgeable, supportive, and always focused on helping you …

Getting back to the gym after a back injury was scary, but training under Raghavendra Sir gave me confidence. He listened to my concerns corrected my form and pushed me only when my body was ready. Today I feel stronger and more confident …
